limitations: Synthetic integer model; 8-byte, 1-KiB and 4-KiB complete states, 1/8/32/128/512 replay ticks. Not actual engine/physics/network performance.
Setup, admitted snapshot preparation, input capture/retention, history admission, transport, rendering and frame scheduling excluded. No effects.

Same preverified snapshot fixture for all correction paths. Indexed input fixture verifies descriptors without per-read hashing; captured adapter scans full descriptors and rechecks payload digests. Difference includes both behaviors.
Captured array has 512 retained entries; replay starts at its first entry. Later suffixes in an unpruned array can scan longer prefixes.
One-tick chunks execute consecutively; no wait between simulated frames. Full latency includes planning/reservation/restore/replay/validation/publication.
Host had other active processes; frequency, scheduling and caches uncontrolled. Repeated distributions are not confidence intervals or universal slowdown percentages.
Allocations measured separately using Rust System allocator instrumentation; callback behavior can change results.
